strings.en: You'll vanish here!
We received your data/　from Golaikunru!
I won't let you interfere with Lord Herluga!
Our power, for Lord Herluga!
Your advance ends here!
Lord Herluga will create/　the future of Gadisword!
Anyone who obstructs the plan will be eliminated!
We'll show you our power!
We're not as soft as those Anex!
You won't lay a hand on the Rabulpaila!
I'll finish you off along with Fairy Klibia!
Death to traitors!
Die with the Earthlings, Fairy Klibia!
You disgrace to Gadisword!
Sieg Altolied, I will execute you!
Death to the Anex traitor!
Sally Emil! Atone for your crimes with your life!
To think an Anex regular/　would betray Gadisword...!
Death to all who defy Lord Herluga!
The perfect opponent to earn some glory!
Once we defeat the Steel Dragons, the rest...!
Zemon is ours!
You won't get near the Rabulpaila and Zemon!
We can't let the Granzon/　reach Lord Herluga!
We have to stop it no matter what!
Target the Steel Dragons' mothership!
Strike the mothership and isolate them!
I won't let you have your way, Grungust!
So that's the Grungust type!
I'll take you down, Grungust!
Swinging a big sword around isn't everything!
So that's the Double G!
If we beat the Double G, their morale...!
A Hückebein imitation is nothing!
It's just a dead copy!
I have to watch out for that Hückebein...!
I'll destroy them before they combine!
If we strike while they're separated!
Combining should have lowered its mobility!
Even the SRX, under concentrated fire!
With such a complex structure, damage/　should cause trouble easily!
I won't let it get inside my guard!
It's bad at long range! If we attack from afar!
Tch, nimble little thing!
Earth has weapons like that...?!
Whatever these Choukijin things are!
A defective patchwork unit is nothing!
I'll circle around from its blind spot!
Bigger isn't always better!
A conspicuous target! It must have lots of blind spots!
I'll crush the high-energy mobile weapons first!
A sluggish one like you is nothing!
Thick armor or not, if we concentrate our fire!
I won't give you time to transform!
That Super Robot has a lot of gear!
We've got both mobility and acceleration too!
Space combat is our specialty!
Its speed is formidable...!
The fastest unit isn't necessarily the strongest!
No matter how modified, it's an old model at heart!
It's just a modified old model!
I can't let it use the Cyflash!
I have to finish off Cybuster quickly!
I'll cut off those heads one by one!
You're the ones who started this!
I won't miss my chance to counter!
You won't escape!
You're not getting away!
You didn't even know you were lured out!
This fight isn't over yet!
There's no retreat for us!
I'll accomplish the mission no matter what!
Gwaaaaah!
Is-is this the end!?
L-Lord Herluga, Gadisword is...!
Comrades of Rattma, the rest is up to you!!
L-Lord Herluga!!
Th-This can't be!!
Th-The Royal Guard's honor is at stake!
W-We have to buy time no matter what!
We have to stop them here...!!
I'll stop them, even if it costs my life!
I'll show you the pride of the Rattma!!
I-I was chosen for the Royal Guard! Not here!
Ugh! My mission isn't over yet!
Gaaah, I've lost control!!
Fairy Klibia! Just you wait!
Ngh! I'll wipe you out for sure, traitor!
W-We, beaten by mere rebels?!
This fight isn't over yet, Grungust!
I never imagined the Grungust was this powerful!
And that's supposed to be a dead copy?!
Just how much power is hidden/　in that Hückebein?!
Ngh! And the SRX is supposed to be a prototype?!
Grr, what charging power!
I-Is it a monster in performance/　as well as looks?!
Our intel said that thing was defective...!
N-No good! I can't let that power overwhelm me!
D-Damn that Garmraid,/　just how many ways can it attack?!
T-To be toyed with by the Hyperlion...!
W-We must stop the Dygenguar at all costs!
Can't we even buy time against the Double G?!
Damn that Cybuster! Is it still hiding its power?!
I-It's the Majin! The blue Majin!!
Grr! I won't let you get past here!
They've seen through our movements?!
Blast it, to be pushed back this hard...!
Ngh! We of the Royal Guard won't fall to this!
So the enemy are skilled fighters too...!
Ngh! Did I take a hit somewhere bad...?!
The unity of the Rattma won't waver from this!
We'll defend the Rabulpaila to the death!
Damn that Fairy Klibia, she's a real pain!
Ngh! You're desperate, traitor!
That's far enough, rebel!
If the Grungust keeps pushing us back...!
It's supposed to be a dead copy, but it hits hard...!
If I can just stop it moving, that gun platform is...!
Even if it's the latest Hückebein...!
They'll be trouble if they Combine. I must end this fast!
Ngh! Damn you, SRX!
Ngh! So it lives up to being an ace unit!
Tch! I can't read that thing's trajectory!
That patchwork machine! You'll pay for that!
Ngh! Don't think size decides the fight!
That's more firepower than the data showed!
Damn that Garmraid, I never expected such range!
I can't read the Cerberus's reach...!
That machine's performance is/　even stranger than its looks!
Ngh! Damn you, Dygenguar! You'll pay for that!
The Double G is formidable indeed!
I have to get out of the Aussenseiter's range...!
Ngh! That thing doesn't move like a machine!
Ngh! I can't read the Dragous's attacks!
Damn that Cybuster, it's singled me out!
S-So this is the power of the Granzon!
Ngh! So this is the power of the Neo Granzon!
Hmph, it's only a scratch!
As if that would frighten me!
You mean to defy Lord Herluga with that?
You needn't bother holding back!
Don't underestimate the Royal Guard!
That's right, I'll be your opponent!
You mean to invade the Rabulpaila with that?
Damn you, Fairy Klibia!/　I'll make you see that resistance is futile!
Don't get cocky, you Anex traitor!
Traitor, I won't let you go any further!
What good is defying/　Lord Herluga for the likes of you?!
How feeble, Grungust!
The Grungust is nothing special!
Fancy armor, but its power is no different/　from a mass-production unit's.
Hmph, riding that thing won't help you!
Why is Golaikunru wary of/　such a pathetic mobile weapon?
It's nothing to worry about when it's not combined.
Is that all you can do even when combined?!
If this is all the ATX Team's main unit can do...!
Are those wings just for show?!
It moves well for a patchwork job!
Tch! It's quick for such a giant!
All those weapons, and this is it?!
Two machines' worth of power, and that's all?!
What's wrong?/　Is the Dragous on your chest just decoration?!
Ugh! What's with that speed?!
An old mass-production unit is no match for me!
Don't think you can cut down/　the resolve of the Royal Guard!
Ugh! It's faster than the Dygenguar?!
Hmph, it doesn't move as well as the Dygenguar.
Tch, damn that Dragous!
You're below your data, Cybuster!
Is that all?/　Golaikunru overestimates that thing.
Earth's weapons are nothing to fear!
Too by-the-book!
As if that'd hit me!
Too slow!
A warning, now of all times?!
Just as expected!
Might've hit if I were one of the Anex lot.
Are you even trying to hit me?
Don't underestimate us!
You think an attack like that will work?
What you lack is brains!
Go ahead, keep wasting your effort!
Tch, how careless of me...!
Ngh, I'll let you go this time!
Can't even counterattack?!
Hmph, lucky devil.
Cheeky tricks!
So you can fight smart too!
Tch, out of range...!
I need to change position!
I lost sight of the enemy?!
I'll push through like this!
I won't give you time to regroup!
Too late to notice me now!
Lady Reggiane, I'll support you!
Lady Reggiane, I gratefully accept!
Lord Herluga, leave the rest to me!
I can take this one!
I'll buy you time to fall back!
I'll protect my Rattma comrades!
I'll be Lady Reggiane's shield!
I won't let you lay a hand on Lord Herluga!
The tide is on our side!
Couldn't get away in time, eh?
I'll settle this in one go!
Hmph, a perfect target!
I won't miss!
Go down!
There!
Try this!
Target locked!
Move however you like!
Take this!
Raaaah!
Hah!
Hyaah!
You're mine!
Haaah!
Take this!!
I'll knock you out of the sky!
Aiming! I've got it!
I'll hit you!
All right, locked on!
Take this!
Lock on!
First, this!
Got you!
Pinning it down!
This is the real deal!
Take this!!
It is not over yet!
Goooo!!
This will finish you!
Take this!!
The Gyanonia can catch up!
One more for good measure!!
From this Gyanonia...
Don't think you can escape!
At this range!
Take this!
I'll keep up the pressure!!
Muzzles deploy!
Fire!
Maximum output! Be blown away!!
I'll use the Breast Blaster!
I'll burn you to ashes!!
